rationale: The obligation asks whether available evidence establishes that the facility under evaluation is the permittee named on the permit cover page. The packet grounds permit cover page permittee identification (City of Aztec - Water Treatment Plant, permit NM0028762) but contains no facility identifiers from measurement or monitoring records—the second value required for comparison. Without monitoring/measurement-side identifiers, identity between the permittee designation and any facility under evaluation cannot be established. ACCEPT would require positive linking evidence; REJECT would require evidence the referents cannot coincide. Neither burden is met, so UNRESOLVED is the correct disposition.
